resources.string: Microphone permission is required to transcribe your voice.
Accurate records audio and uses AI transcription. Live types while you speak.
Live typing uses the device speech recognizer. Beta; Accurate stays available as fallback.
After you stop, send live text to the AI provider for grammar and translation.
Use the on-device speech model when Android 12+ offers it.
Ask before downloading a speech model over cellular data.
Auto Detect is never sent to the recognizer; pick the spoken language here.
Live text is sent to your selected AI provider only when auto-refine is on. Raw speech text is never logged.
